defense_news.title: Ukraine’s former defense minister launches ‘Manhattan Project’ for killer robots
defense_news.summary: Mykhailo Fedorov told Defense News he wants humanoid-like robots on the battlefield within six months and an assault without infantry within a year.

defense_news.title: Why the Pentagon just dropped $450M on tungsten mining
defense_news.summary: The Pentagon recently announced a $450 million investment in The Elmet Group to strengthen the U.S. supply chain for the critical mineral tungsten.

defense_news.title: US Navy selects Boeing to build next-generation F/A-XX fighter
defense_news.summary: Boeing has officially been selected to build the Navy’s sixth-generation carrier-based strike fighter, dubbed F/A-XX.

defense_news.title: Pentagon awards Raytheon up to $20.7 billion to nearly double AMRAAM production
defense_news.summary: The Defense Department has awarded Raytheon a multiyear contract worth up to $20.7 billion to build Advanced Medium-Range Air-to-Air Missiles, or AMRAAMs.
